findings.conclusion: Reject treating this trade-only file as full quote-event OFI. Future signed-trade proxy needs explicit archive-side semantics; full OFI needs qualified quotes.
findings.source_help_observation: Archive help distinguishes source 0 ordinary orders and 1 retail price improvement orders; these are not buy/sell signs.

sources.finding: OFI uses changes in best bid/ask prices and displayed queue sizes; trade imbalance is a distinct variable. This is a contemporaneous price-impact comparison on US equity data, not evidence of future crypto returns.
sources.title: The price impact of order book events

sources.finding: The visible archive help labels side as buy/sell transaction direction, size as traded quantity, created_time as Unix milliseconds, and source as ordinary versus retail price improvement orders. It does not explicitly say aggressor/taker.
